Explain how a VPN works in simple words
7:47 PM

A VPN is a private tunnel between your device and the internet. Everything you send goes through it in scrambled form, so nobody in between can read it.

Here is how it works:

Your phone or PC connects to a VPN company's machine somewhere else.
Your data is locked (encrypted) before it leaves your device.
The VPN machine unlocks it and sends it on to the website.
The website sees the VPN machine's address, not yours.

This helps on public Wi-Fi, since others on the network can't spy on what you do. It also hides your location from websites. It does not make you fully anonymous, though. The VPN company can still see your traffic, so pick one you trust.
